links.outcome: LLM vs TB physician responses on precision, recall, F1 and subjective ratings
links.effect: Patient education: LLM precision 0.86 vs 0.50 (P<.001), recall 0.53 vs 0.14, F1 0.65 vs 0.22. No significant objective differences for medication counseling and follow-up planning (all P>.050). LLMs rated higher on suitability, understandability, empathy.
links.quote: Conversely, no statistically significant differences were observed in objective metrics for medication counseling and follow-up planning (all P > .050), although LLMs demonstrated a tendency toward broader but more discordant coverage.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the feasibility and comparative accuracy/quality of LLMs versus physicians on standardized post-discharge tuberculosis clinical vignettes without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
